title: Fernwick (SNES)
description: A small top-down sword-and-key adventure, the SNES twin of the TG16 toy: BG1 ground, BG2 canopies over the hero, a BG3 HUD, colour-math shadows and wisps, a windowed lantern and iris, a Mode 7 title and S-DSP music. Game logic shared with crates/tg16-core/toys/fernwick.
